MobClassEntity.Name: Canine
MobClassEntity.Description: Fast and aggressive demonic hounds that close distance quickly to tear apart their prey in melee.

MobClassEntity.Name: Zombie
MobClassEntity.Description: Reanimated military personnel. Slow but relentless, they retain enough muscle memory to use their weapons.

MobClassEntity.Name: Imp
MobClassEntity.Description: Common foot soldiers of Hell. They hurl fireballs at range and slash with their claws up close.

MobClassEntity.Name: Specter
MobClassEntity.Description: Ethereal creatures that drift through the darkness. Semi-transparent and hard to hit.

MobClassEntity.Name: Demon
MobClassEntity.Description: Massive horned brutes that charge headlong into battle and tear through armour with sheer force.

MobClassEntity.Name: Cacodemon
MobClassEntity.Description: Floating one-eyed monstrosities that spit balls of plasma and electrical energy.

MobClassEntity.Name: Pain Elemental
MobClassEntity.Description: Bloated demonic entities that vomit Lost Souls from their gaping maws as a form of attack.

MobClassEntity.Name: Revenant
MobClassEntity.Description: Skeletal warriors outfitted with shoulder-mounted rocket launchers. They track their targets relentlessly.

MobClassEntity.Name: Behemoth
MobClassEntity.Description: A colossal demonic titan of immense power. Its every step shakes the ground beneath it.

MobClassEntity.Name: Mancubus
MobClassEntity.Description: Grotesquely obese demons with mechanical arms that fire barrages of incendiary projectiles.

MobClassEntity.Name: Archvile
MobClassEntity.Description: Terrifying demons that can resurrect slain enemies and incinerate targets with hellfire from a distance.

MobClassEntity.Name: Knight
MobClassEntity.Description: Elite demonic warriors clad in hellforged armour. They combine brutal melee attacks with ranged plasma blasts.

MobClassEntity.Name: Boss
MobClassEntity.Description: Titanic demonic overlords of immense power and resilience. Encountering one is a fight for survival.
